<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 224.120115, which matches the exact monoisotopic mass of C₁₆H₁₆O (16 × 12.0000 + 16 × 1.007825 + 15.994915 = 224.120115). The observed M+1 intensity (~17 %) also fits the expected 13C contribution for 16 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₆O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H16O</final_answer>
